t: The answer to who He is
a: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
p: Qul huwa-llāhu aḥad, Allāhu-ṣ-ṣamad, lam yalid wa lam yūlad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad.
m: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One, Allāh, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
